name: The Leveret Spirit
source:
While clinging onto the last embers of a dying MMO, a group of friends follow whispers of a hidden quest forgotten by the developers. 

Set in 2011, this visual novel explores feelings of burnout and insecurity, and how that impacts yourself and those around you. 

[From [url=https://team-qoatl.itch.io/the-leveret-spirit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群朋友在抓紧濒临死亡的MMO的最后余烬时，追踪着被开发者遗忘的隐藏任务的低语。

这部视觉小说以2011年为背景，探讨了倦怠和不安全感，以及这对你自己和周围人的影响。

[来自[url=https://team-qoatl.itch.io/the-leveret-spirit]Itch.io[/url]]
